case_title: LACHHMAN DASS v. RESHAM CHAND KALER AND ANR.
aggravating_circumstances: Criminal conspiracy, use of deadly weapons, serious injury, death caused
neutral_facts: The accused, along with other persons, arrived at a crime scene where a dispute occurred with the victim and his associate. During the altercation, one of the accused fired a shot from a revolver, resulting in the victim's death. The victim and his family sustained injuries from the accused and their associates. The police investigation identified the accused as part of a criminal conspiracy, and additional charges were added to the case. The trial court rejected the accused's bail application due to the serious nature of the offense, while the High Court granted bail, which was later overturned by the Supreme Court.
